title: HEALING WORD
FOR YOUR SOUL
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: glowing golden light flowing over still water
white dove wings in soft ethereal mist
warm sunlight streaming through stained glass
serene garden waterfall in morning light
breeze blowing through field of lilies

scenes.a: Right now, as that recurring worry pulls at your heart, let stillness cover your spirit.
Listen to the promise that shifts your heavy burden into the hands of the Savior.
That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
Lord, take these infirmities that weigh so heavily upon this dear one today, we pray.
May your presence bring rest to the weary parts of their mind and tired body.
Let your healing peace fill this space until they feel truly whole and entirely held.
